source.description:
## PROBLEM
Final extension and mandatory-rules work is reviewed but not integrated, documented, re-vendored, release-tested, or published. Interactive agents also underuse Python and ast-grep.
## SUCCESS
Specialists and Core ship precise README-first docs, stronger bounded tool routing, fresh release evidence, and operator-gated publication.
## SCOPE
Specialists final branch 66087bb3, Core candidate 4d61f233, README/CHANGELOG, prompt/advisory extensions, vendor and release gates.
## NON_GOALS
No permission weakening. No publication without explicit final confirmation.
## CONSTRAINTS
SCRUTINY: critical. Preserve native Pi extension behavior and deterministic artifacts. Global prompt surface is HIGH risk: 11 upstream across four processes.
## VALIDATION
- [ ] Integration and deterministic builds pass.
- [ ] README and release notes are precise.
- [ ] Python/ast-grep routing is conditional and tested.
- [ ] Core vendor and fresh Alpine/glibc gates pass.
- [ ] Publication remains operator-gated.
## LIBRARIES
Existing repository and release tooling only.
## OUTPUT
Final SHAs, hashes, release notes, evidence, blocker adjudication, and publication verification.
source.title: Release Pi extensions, mandatory rules, and stronger tool routing
